name: Methylphenidate Transdermal
summary: Daytrana is a skin patch form of methylphenidate that releases the medicine through the skin over about 9 hours; it is approved for ADHD in children and teens aged 6–17.
description: Daytrana is a skin patch (transdermal) form of methylphenidate that releases the medicine through the skin over about 9 hours. It is approved for ADHD in children and teens aged 6–17. The patch is an option for people who cannot take or swallow pills and lets you adjust how long it works each day by changing how long you wear it.
